subject: website
name: Orivon website
summary: The Orivon release website, judged here by its own publisher. Its source is public (Apache-2.0) and it is served as written, so it runs only its own code: no analytics, tag manager or embed. It stays at 3 because as it opens it reads the newest release from latest.orivonstack.eth.limo, a gateway whose answer nothing checks against a hash (a Level 1 connection that sees the visitor's IP address). If that read fails, the page shows the release it was built with.

operations.name: Read the project pages and choose a download
operations.note: The text, images, fonts and scripts are the page's own files.

operations.name: Show the newest release
operations.note: Read from a gateway as the page opens; the page's built-in release stands in when it does not answer.

connections.name: latest.orivonstack.eth.limo (newest release)
connections.note: An eth.limo gateway answers; nothing checks its answer against a hash. It sees the visitor's IP address.
